map.由波长与孔径直径，按 θ = 1.22λ/D 计算光学系统最小可分辨角。: From the wavelength and aperture diameter, compute the minimum resolvable angle of an optical system using θ = 1.22λ/D.
map.瑞利判据：两点光源恰可分辨时，一波前极大与另一波前第一极小重合。: Rayleigh criterion: two point sources are just resolvable when the maximum of one wavefront coincides with the first minimum of the other.
map.人眼瞳孔约 2–5mm，可见光下分辨极限约 1′（角分）。: The human pupil is about 2-5mm; the resolution limit in visible light is about 1′ (arcminute).
map.由波长与 NA 算最小可分辨距离。: From the wavelength and NA, compute the minimum resolvable distance.
map.选高 NA 或短波提分辨。: Choose high NA or a shorter wavelength to improve resolution.
map.λ=550nm、NA=1.4（油镜）→ d=0.61×550/1.4≈240nm: λ=550nm, NA=1.4 (oil objective) → d=0.61×550/1.4≈240nm, the theoretical limit of an optical microscope (~0.2μm).
map.改用 UV λ=365nm 或 NA 1.5 → d≈149nm；再小须电子/扫: Switching to UV λ=365nm or NA 1.5 → d≈149nm; to go smaller you need electron/scanning-probe methods to break the diffraction limit.
map.两物点 Airy 斑中心距≥第一暗环（1.22λ/2NA）即恰可分辨，取 0.6: Two object points are just resolvable when the separation of their Airy disk centers is ≥ the first dark ring (1.22λ/2NA); take 0.61λ/NA as the spacing.
map.受衍射极限，光学 ~200nm；超分辨靠 STED/PALM 等绕过瑞利极限。: Limited by the diffraction limit, optics reaches ~200nm; super-resolution bypasses the Rayleigh limit via STED/PALM and similar methods.
